synopsis: Diego is a talented but restless young trumpeter who decides to leave Rome—and his girlfriend, Alice—behind to join his mentor, Nacho, in Argentina. However, on the other side of the world, neither contracts nor certainty about the future await him, and the journey soon proves to be more existential than professional.  In Buenos Aires, Diego finds himself immersed in a vibrant new world filled with nights of music, color, and feverish improvisation. Above all, he rediscovers love in Camila, a young aspiring translator who captures his heart.
